input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include login, login impl, user details impl. Core business data revolves around RequestLoginUser, SecurityModelFactory, User. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a User, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a User, I want to interact with login impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a User, I want to interact with user details impl functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
